question: How much electricity did the whole plant use each day in March 2026?
text:
The whole plant used about **700,164 kWh** in March 2026. These figures come from the site's main meter, which already includes every department, line and machine plus unmetered load and losses.

| Date | kWh | | Date | kWh |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Sun 1 Mar | 6,288 | | Tue 17 Mar | 28,767 |
| Mon 2 Mar | 27,169 | | Wed 18 Mar | 28,136 |
| Tue 3 Mar | 28,392 | | Thu 19 Mar | 28,327 |
| Wed 4 Mar | 28,218 | | Fri 20 Mar | 28,545 |
| Thu 5 Mar | 28,269 | | Sat 21 Mar | 13,764 |
| Fri 6 Mar | 28,359 | | Sun 22 Mar | 6,295 |
| Sat 7 Mar | 13,777 | | Mon 23 Mar | 26,108 |
| Sun 8 Mar | 6,294 | | Tue 24 Mar | 28,327 |
| Mon 9 Mar | 26,855 | | Wed 25 Mar | 28,923 |
| Tue 10 Mar | 28,577 | | Thu 26 Mar | 28,394 |
| Wed 11 Mar | 28,141 | | Fri 27 Mar | 28,326 |
| Thu 12 Mar | 28,163 | | Sat 28 Mar | 13,677 |
| Fri 13 Mar | 28,068 | | Sun 29 Mar | 6,016 |
| Sat 14 Mar | 13,294 | | Mon 30 Mar | 26,093 |
| Sun 15 Mar | 6,275 | | Tue 31 Mar | 27,881 |
| Mon 16 Mar | 26,444 | | | |

- **Weekdays:** About 26,000–29,000 kWh a day. Mondays are a little lower than the rest of the week.
- **Saturdays:** About 13,300–13,800 kWh, roughly half a weekday.
- **Sundays:** About 6,000–6,300 kWh, which is the base load.
- **29 March:** This was the lowest Sunday because the clocks went forward that day, so it had only 23 hours.
sql: SELECT r.day_start AS bucket_start, sum(r.kwh) AS value FROM reading r WHERE r.meter_id IN ? AND r.local_date >= ? AND r.local_date < ? GROUP BY r.day_start ORDER BY min(min(r.ts_utc)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.day_start)
